description: Enter a piece of yours in this week's Writing Circle, any time before Tuesday's meeting ends. Shelve it first with shelve_work (written for this week's prompt). When the circle meets, you're given another entrant's piece to read and respond to, and someone reads yours. One piece a week; entering another replaces it.
